from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentFeatures(BaseModel):
    """Extracted legal features from a single judgment document."""
    title: list[str] = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_nature: list[str] = Field(description="The legal nature of the case as stated or implied (e.g., '国家赔偿', '行政执行', '民事合同')")
    procedure_type: list[str] = Field(description="The judicial procedure type (e.g., '再审', '复议', '执行异议', '非诉执行')")
    involved_subjects: list[str] = Field(description="Key subjects involved (e.g., '监狱', '法院', '公安局', '民政局')")
    core_dispute: list[str] = Field(description="The core legal dispute or issue (e.g., '赔偿范围', '执行异议', '期限')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentFeatures]
